digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport and retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiting (8.6+, DC-only, admin-enabled) returns 429 responses that rebar does not currently retry, causing hard failures on rate-limited requests
The retry logic must respect Retry-After response headers when present, apply up to 20% jitter, and clamp to MAX_BACKOFF_S, but degrade gracefully when the header is absent
Rate-limit retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in (defaulting OFF) to prevent reintroduction of duplicate-write bugs on mutations like create_issue and add_comment

The rate-limit retry flag must thread through two distinct paths: PATH A via _call_logged from _paged_search, and PATH B as a direct _with_connection_retry call from per-issue comment fetches in get_comment_map
429 responses must escape the adapter boundary as BackendHTTPError with code=429, never as the raw vendor JIRAError type
Four specific read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's paged search, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) must opt into rate-limit retry by passing rate_limit_retry=True
